_handoff.scopeNote: Five BESCOM exception journeys branch from IND-6's canonical clean-sale chain. Direct current public-official interface observations are Grade B. The official BESCOM-hosted Clause 36 copy is Grade A but partial because its consolidated content is dated 2013. Authenticated fields, EPID mapping, backend repair, and outcome timing remain Unknown.

sources.title: Conditions of Supply of Electricity with I and II Amendments
sources.notes: Officially hosted consolidated copy. Its content/pagination is dated 2013, therefore statutory-text claims are Grade A but partial for current procedural applicability.

sources.title: Track Name Change
sources.notes: Current public interface asks for the Request ID sent by SMS and displays 1912 help.

sources.title: BESCOM FAQ — How To Change Name?
sources.notes: Current public FAQ observes the authenticated JVS name-change workflow, but does not enumerate its field-level document eligibility.

sources.title: e-Aasthi citizen login and Final e-Khata instructions
sources.notes: Current public interface distinguishes Draft e-Khata and guidance for Final e-Khata.

sources.title: e-Aasthi public e-Khata search
sources.notes: Current public search supports ward, SAS property-tax ID, and property EPID; it exposes a missing-property route.

sources.title: e-Khata Application Status
sources.notes: Current public status interface accepts an EPID and displays the e-Khata helpline; it does not document BESCOM mapping.

claims.text: Clause 36.01 says the registered consumer is to furnish consent to transfer the installation and deposits held in that consumer's name.
claims.notes: The officially hosted copy is historic; current portal material inspected does not restate the rule.

claims.text: In the absence of consent, Clause 36.01 lists registered sale deed, partition deed, khata, succession or heirship certificate, and deed of last will as ownership-evidence alternatives.
claims.notes: Do not infer that every historical alternative is accepted by the current authenticated form.

claims.text: In the absence of consent, Clause 36.01 lists valid power of attorney, latest rent-paid receipt, or valid lease deed as occupancy evidence only for non-commercial lighting and non-commercial combined lighting-and-heating installations.
claims.notes: This limitation must not be generalized to commercial installations.

claims.text: Clause 36.01 requires the transferee to execute an indemnity bond for disputes arising from the transfer.
claims.notes: The current public FAQ does not expose the form or its present upload handling.

claims.text: Clause 36.01 states that no arrears may be outstanding against the installation.
claims.notes: No inspected public current interface exposes an arrears-clearing sequence.

claims.text: Clause 30.10 publishes transfer charges of Rs.100 per LT installation and Rs.500 per HT installation.
claims.notes: Historic official schedule; current payable amount must be checked in the live demand/payment flow.

claims.text: Clause 36.01 requires the transferee to execute a fresh power-supply agreement.
claims.notes: The current public FAQ does not say where or how the agreement is completed.

claims.text: Clause 36.01 says a fresh deposit as for a new consumer is payable when consent to transfer the registered consumer's deposit is absent, and says no additional deposit is demanded when that consent is produced.
claims.notes: Current calculation and payment timing are not publicly verified.

claims.text: BESCOM's current FAQ directs a name-change applicant to authenticate, select JVS Name change/Change of Ownership, choose an account ID, complete mandatory fields, upload required documents, submit, retain the displayed Request ID, and pay applicable charges.
claims.notes: Post-login fields, document list, account/EPID eligibility, and backend behavior were not observed.

claims.text: BESCOM's current public name-change tracker requests the Request ID sent by SMS.
claims.notes: The tracker does not establish approval or updated-bill timing.

claims.text: The current e-Aasthi public guidance says Draft e-Khata is available after mobile-OTP login and directs citizens to upload additional information for Final e-Khata, including registered deed, eKYC, SAS property-tax application number, property photo, and A-Khata documents; it says encumbrance certificate is needed only when immediate sale or transfer is planned.
claims.notes: This establishes municipal guidance, not that BESCOM requires Final e-Khata.

claims.text: The current public e-Aasthi search offers a Do not find my property eKhata submission route when the property cannot be found.
claims.notes: Later processing state and turnaround are not established.

claims.text: The current public e-Khata Application Status page accepts an EPID for status lookup and publishes the e-Khata helpline.
claims.notes: The page does not describe EPID-to-BESCOM account mapping.

claims.text: No inspected public official material establishes eligibility rules, failure messages, repair owner, or recovery sequence for mapping an EPID to a BESCOM account.
claims.notes: Do not turn the visible public Name Change with EPID entry into an inferred mapping contract.

nodes.label: Transfer evidence
nodes.summary: Consent, ownership, or scope-limited occupancy evidence for an exception transfer.
nodes.requiredState: Use consent or the appropriate Clause 36.01 alternative; tenant occupancy alternatives are textually limited to specified non-commercial installations.

checks.label: Choose evidence branch
checks.description: Separate ownership or succession evidence from tenant occupancy evidence.

failureSignals.label: Evidence does not fit
failureSignals.description: Consent is absent but no listed alternative is available, or tenant use falls outside the stated scope.

recoveries.label: Confirm current acceptance
recoveries.description: Use authorized BESCOM support or authenticated workflow for case-specific acceptance; no public current checklist was observed.

nodes.label: Transfer obligations
nodes.summary: Arrears, indemnity, fee, agreement, and deposit conditions recorded in Clause 36.01.
nodes.requiredState: No arrears; indemnity and fresh agreement; applicable transfer fee; deposit handling depends on deposit-transfer consent.

checks.label: Apply obligations
checks.description: Historical text requires no arrears, indemnity, fee, fresh agreement, and sometimes a fresh deposit.

failureSignals.label: Outstanding arrears
failureSignals.description: The historical clause says arrears block transfer; current public clearing sequence was not found.

recoveries.label: Obtain current demand
recoveries.description: The FAQ says the authenticated request exposes applicable payment information; it does not validate historic values as current.

nodes.label: Authenticated BESCOM name-change request
nodes.summary: The current public FAQ's post-login JVS name-change path.
nodes.requiredState: Authorized user can authenticate, select an account ID, complete mandatory fields, and upload required documents.

checks.label: Submit JVS request
checks.description: The FAQ describes authentication, account selection, mandatory fields, document upload, and submission.

failureSignals.label: Post-login validation unknown
failureSignals.description: No private fields, error states, EPID eligibility, or document list was observed.

nodes.label: Name-change request tracking
nodes.summary: Public tracking state keyed by the Request ID sent by SMS.
nodes.requiredState: Retain the Request ID after submission.

checks.label: Track Request ID
checks.description: The public tracker asks for the Request ID sent by SMS.

failureSignals.label: Outcome timing unknown
failureSignals.description: The tracker does not establish approval or updated-bill timing.

edges.label: Historical conditions list these obligations for transfer.
The documented public workflow produces a Request ID after submission.

roadblocks.title: Tenant route outside stated non-commercial scope
roadblocks.symptom: An occupier seeks transfer for an installation that may not fit the historical non-commercial scope.
roadblocks.likelyCause: The occupancy alternative is explicitly limited and current authenticated eligibility is not publicly documented.
roadblocks.recovery: Do not assume tenant eligibility; confirm current evidence and installation category through authorized BESCOM channels.

roadblocks.title: Successor evidence cannot be confirmed in the current form
roadblocks.symptom: The prior consumer is deceased and consent cannot be obtained.
roadblocks.likelyCause: Clause 36.01 lists succession/heirship certificate or will, but the public FAQ does not enumerate current uploads.
roadblocks.recovery: Use the listed alternative as a historical evidence lead and confirm acceptance in the official authorized workflow.

roadblocks.title: Consent unavailable and deposit treatment unresolved
roadblocks.symptom: The applicant cannot furnish consent for transfer and deposit transfer.
roadblocks.likelyCause: The historic rule substitutes evidence but also describes a fresh-deposit consequence.
roadblocks.recovery: Prepare the applicable historical alternative and verify the current demand/deposit amount; do not use historic amounts as current.

roadblocks.title: Arrears block transfer but public clearing path is not documented
roadblocks.symptom: An outstanding balance may prevent transfer.
roadblocks.likelyCause: Clause 36.01 states no arrears may be outstanding; no public remediation sequence was found.
roadblocks.recovery: Resolve billing through an authorized BESCOM path before retrying; exact current sequence remains unknown.

roadblocks.title: Current uploaded-document checklist is not public
roadblocks.symptom: The FAQ route is visible but the pre-login document checklist cannot be verified.
roadblocks.likelyCause: The current FAQ says to upload required documents without listing them.
roadblocks.recovery: Use the authorized route only; retain the Request ID if submitted and do not infer errors or bypass login.

journeys.title: Draft or pending e-Khata before the BESCOM request
journeys.context: Branch from IND-6's sale-deed to Final e-Khata to EPID to BESCOM-mapping chain. Public evidence confirms Draft/Final e-Khata guidance, but does not prove BESCOM rejects Draft or requires Final e-Khata.

steps.label: Inspect e-Khata state
steps.action: Use public search/status without submitting personal data.
steps.expectedResult: Discoverability and any available EPID/status state.

steps.label: Follow Final e-Khata guidance
steps.action: Where only Draft exists, follow the official Final e-Khata input guidance.
steps.expectedResult: Municipal record work can proceed; BESCOM impact remains unverified.

steps.label: Preserve mapping uncertainty
steps.action: Do not infer that Final e-Khata produces an EPID-to-BESCOM mapping.

steps.label: Use documented request route if eligible
steps.action: Authorized user may use JVS Name change/Change of Ownership.
steps.expectedResult: A submission can yield a Request ID; eligibility remains separate.

dependencies.description: IND-6 marks this as partial/inferred rather than verified.
Public evidence does not establish this mapping/transfer handoff.

recoveryNotes: Use official Final e-Khata guidance and public search/status; do not promise that it unblocks BESCOM.
Use the official missing-property route when absent.
Retain BESCOM Request ID if an authorized request is submitted.
documentationQualityNotes: Municipal Draft/Final guidance is current public evidence (B).
The municipal-to-BESCOM mapping chain remains partial or unknown.

journeys.title: EPID exists or is expected, but BESCOM mapping fails
journeys.context: IND-6 mapping-failure branch. Public official interfaces expose EPID-based e-Khata status and BESCOM name-change routes, but not mapping rules or repair ownership.

steps.label: Check municipal EPID status
steps.action: Use public status only with an EPID already held by the user.
steps.expectedResult: Municipal status lookup; it does not establish BESCOM mapping.

steps.label: Check property discoverability
steps.action: Use public search and its missing-property route if absent.
steps.expectedResult: A municipal recovery entry, not a demonstrated BESCOM repair.

steps.label: Keep mapping behavior unknown
steps.action: Do not infer format rules, error text, repair owner, or offline fallback.

steps.label: Use authorized BESCOM route only when eligible
steps.action: Use authorized login and retain a Request ID if accepted.
steps.expectedResult: A public workflow exists, not proof of mapping repair.

dependencies.description: The relationship is not publicly specified.

recoveryNotes: Use municipal property/status channels for municipal-side discoverability and BESCOM authorized support for the utility-side case.
No inspected official source assigns mapping repair or a turnaround.
documentationQualityNotes: Public endpoints are evidenced; their cross-system contract is not.
Do not treat an EPID-labelled public entry as a proven successful mapping path.

journeys.title: Tenant or occupier seeks transfer
journeys.context: Historical Clause 36.01 alternative is limited to specified non-commercial installations. It joins BESCOM's current authenticated request path without inferring current field-level acceptance.

steps.label: Assess tenant-route scope
steps.action: Distinguish the stated non-commercial scope from commercial or unverified use.
steps.expectedResult: Historically described evidence branch or explicit out-of-scope uncertainty.

steps.label: Prepare occupancy evidence
steps.action: Use the historic valid power-of-attorney, rent-receipt, or lease-deed alternatives as evidence leads when consent is absent.
steps.expectedResult: Evidence ready for current acceptance check.

steps.label: Address obligations
steps.action: Address arrears, indemnity, fee, fresh agreement, and deposit treatment.
steps.expectedResult: Transfer package subject to current confirmation.

steps.label: Submit and track if eligible
steps.action: Use JVS only with authorization and retain Request ID after successful submission.
steps.expectedResult: Trackable request, not guaranteed approval or updated bill.

dependencies.description: Tenant evidence does not remove the other historical transfer obligations.

recoveryNotes: Do not present occupancy evidence as a universal tenant entitlement.
For commercial or unclear use, current eligibility must be confirmed rather than inferred.
documentationQualityNotes: Grade A supports historical text but only partially supports current handling.
The current public FAQ confirms a route, not a tenant-specific checklist.

journeys.title: Previous consumer is deceased; successor seeks transfer
journeys.context: Consent-unavailable ownership branch. It can intersect with IND-6's municipal chain, but no evidence establishes that municipal Final e-Khata or EPID is a current prerequisite for this exception transfer.

steps.label: Choose successor ownership evidence
steps.action: Use the historic list including succession/heirship certificate or deed of last will; do not invent a death-only portal rule.
steps.expectedResult: Documented evidence lead for absent consent.

steps.label: Address obligations
steps.action: Address arrears, indemnity, fee, fresh agreement, and deposit; verify current values live.

steps.label: Use JVS and retain Request ID
steps.action: If the authorized account path permits submission, use the documented FAQ route.
steps.expectedResult: Trackable request; document validation and outcome remain unverified.

dependencies.description: Alternative ownership evidence does not remove other recorded obligations.

recoveryNotes: Use the successor-evidence list as a lead only and confirm current acceptance.
Follow IND-6 municipal recovery separately if the property record also needs updating.
documentationQualityNotes: No current public FAQ enumerates a deceased-consumer route.
Municipal record and BESCOM transfer routes are not linked by a verified public rule.

journeys.title: Prior-consumer consent unavailable
journeys.context: General Clause 36.01 exception. Historical text supplies ownership or limited occupancy alternatives and related obligations; it converges on the documented current BESCOM request/tracker states without assuming eligibility.

steps.label: Select evidence alternative
steps.action: Use consent if present; otherwise distinguish listed ownership evidence from narrow non-commercial occupancy evidence.
steps.expectedResult: Classified exception branch instead of an assumed workaround.

steps.label: Handle liability and deposit
steps.action: Address no arrears, indemnity, fee, fresh agreement, and fresh-deposit consequence where deposit-transfer consent is absent.
steps.expectedResult: Known historical obligations and current-value uncertainty.

steps.label: Submit through documented current channel
steps.action: Use authorized JVS name-change flow and track by SMS Request ID when submission is accepted.
steps.expectedResult: Tracked request, not inferred transfer decision.

dependencies.description: Absent consent changes evidence and deposit treatment but leaves other historical obligations in place.
Public FAQ and tracker connect submission to Request ID independent of exception eligibility.

recoveryNotes: Do not manufacture consent or treat historical amounts as current payable demand.
Use authorized BESCOM channels for current document and payment treatment; retain Request ID.
documentationQualityNotes: Historic rule is specific enough to model alternatives and liabilities, not to guarantee current portal behavior.
Current public workflow is B; unobserved authenticated and backend behavior remains Unknown.
